title: Fabric Folds Not Realistic Enough? Who You Gonna Call?
content:
## ![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/10068fcfd9b84fa4a48efc64079901f7Header_thumb%20%283%29.png)_Unnatural wrinkles are the ghosts that haunt digital garments. To bust them, 3D artist Johnny Xiao became an investigator of realism for his Ghostbusters Spengler project. His secret weapon? Not a proton pack of details, but a sharp eye for what to remove._

* * *

# ![7147926abc334e308dc161a583880b9e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/7147926abc334e308dc161a583880b9ejohnny-xiao-zhiqiang-xiao-11.jpg)**Interview with**[**Johnny Xiao**](https://www.artstation.com/johnnyxiao)**|**[**Ghostbusters Spengler**](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/NqmGzd)**| 3D Artist**  


* * *

# **Please introduce yourself to the Marvelous Designer community.**

Hello everyone. I’m Johnny Xiao, a senior 3D artist in the game and film industry.

# **What’s the story behind your work? Why did you decide to recreate Spengler from Ghostbusters?**

I first saw _Ghostbusters_ back in middle school, and it totally stuck with me. I was also super into movies like _Starship Troopers_ , _Back to the Future, and The Fifth Element_. These movies all played a significant role in inspiring me to pursue a career in this industry.

![454e82f2e4014cebba3ddc8836f6a5d0](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/454e82f2e4014cebba3ddc8836f6a5d0johnny-xiao-zhiqiang-xiao-12.jpg)

# **As an experienced Marvelous Designer user, did you apply any unconventional techniques or workflows in this project to enhance the realism or efficiency of the garment creation?**

For this project, I mainly followed a traditional workflow. However, I made extensive use of **_internal lines_** to create **_memory creases_** , which significantly enhanced the realism of the clothing.

I also gathered a lot of references, especially worn garments, to study the subtle details of wrinkling and curling. For example, instead of letting the collar completely droop, I added a slight lift and tension to make it look more natural and lived-in.

![50ae7bafeb85469087b249db24fbb5cb](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/50ae7bafeb85469087b249db24fbb5cbjohnny-xiao-zhiqiang-xiao-14.jpg)

![7bef7d3c2adf48c8ad727a509dd6184c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/7bef7d3c2adf48c8ad727a509dd6184cJohnnyXiao6.jpg)

![c0b174ced7874627ae208dd9e7fb23c8](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/c0b174ced7874627ae208dd9e7fb23c8JohnnyXiao7.jpg)

![7aea9987240745229199958d6bf710d1](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/7aea9987240745229199958d6bf710d1johnnyXiao1.jpg)

![4f55fae2cc9b46e4895bf26e26f09658](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/4f55fae2cc9b46e4895bf26e26f09658JohnnyXiao2.png)

![0c3b3704c5e54feb936c4d3e6ebe64d2](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/0c3b3704c5e54feb936c4d3e6ebe64d2Johnnyxiao1.png)

# **What part of the process do you enjoy the most, and what do you find most challenging?**

Whenever I work on a personal project, I aim to make it better than the last.

The biggest challenge for me is achieving a high level of realism in Marvelous Designer, which requires a great deal of patience and attention to detail. While many artists tend to add more wrinkles to their garments, I believe that **_subtraction is often the key_** —matching folds precisely to real-world references is both the most difficult and the most rewarding part of the process.

![91a61522fc2c47e28b8b0916f9c7759f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/91a61522fc2c47e28b8b0916f9c7759fJohnnyXiao2.jpg)

![f47976a76eef480fb6eba97e39722854](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/f47976a76eef480fb6eba97e39722854johnny-xiao-zhiqiang-xiao-20.jpg)

# **In your opinion, what is Marvelous Designer’s greatest strength in character creation? How did you leverage that in this project?**

In traditional workflows, we often relied on sculpting in ZBrush to achieve realistic clothing, which certainly works well.

However, **_Marvelous Designer significantly improves production efficiency by allowing for rapid garment modeling and the generation of natural-looking folds_**. These folds can be adjusted in real time and respond dynamically to movement, creating a much more lifelike result.

In today’s fast-paced production environment, this is a major advantage. With the current speed of GPU-based simulation and improved stability, quick iteration has become much more feasible, enabling the creation of highly realistic assets with greater efficiency.

![084ecda70e524b00b1c271a74e04edc7](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/084ecda70e524b00b1c271a74e04edc7JohnnyXiao5.jpg)

![ac559a5aa39342a78ec553347154bc44](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/ac559a5aa39342a78ec553347154bc44johnny-xiao-zhiqiang-xiao-16.jpg)![4d44edb926504a768d511027307b3010](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/4d44edb926504a768d511027307b3010johnny-xiao-zhiqiang-xiao-19.jpg)

# **For artists already familiar with Marvelous Designer, how would you recommend further unlocking its potential in character creation?**

As I mentioned earlier, efficiency is everything today.

It’s not about working harder, but working smarter—finding ways to produce high-quality results without spending excessive time manually refining every garment.

Marvelous Designer isn’t a difficult tool to learn, though many are initially discouraged by the pattern-making process. Fortunately, there’s now a wealth of free online assets available. For example, **_the CONNECT store offers a wide range of free assets_**. You can modify these to suit your character, allowing you to quickly create high-quality models with minimal effort.

![fa8379b9afa44674a14ea27084941f4f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/fa8379b9afa44674a14ea27084941f4fCONNECT%20store.png)

![f1e0608c9f0c41b8b153e3a144e9647c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/82276b26a47540da8e2d60799e041cc1/images/f1e0608c9f0c41b8b153e3a144e9647cjohnny-xiao-zhiqiang-xiao-untitled-1.jpg)

[Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/johnny-xiao-183bb724/)

[Artstation](https://www.artstation.com/johnnyxiao)
content_description: Discover how 3D artist Johnny Xiao enhances garment realism in Marvelous Designer by mastering subtle wrinkle subtraction, efficient workflows, and leveraging free assets to create lifelike digital clothing.

title: [Feedback] Flat Patterns? Try It Out & Get a Coupon!
content:
Hello everyone!  
This is the CONNECT Team👋

* * *

Did you notice something new on our main page?

![4a7c92999b794a9191722c30dcb22e30](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/fa0b2917deaf4659b57c9aac812a77e9/images/4a7c92999b794a9191722c30dcb22e30image.png)  
That’s right! We’ve temporarily added a new section called **Flat Patterns** , just below _Curator’s Pick_.

## _👉 So, what are_** _Flat Patterns_** _?_

  
We’ve been curious to see if there’s demand for pattern files in their **_unsewn_** format. That’s why we decided to run a small test together with pattern creator [Minerva](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/548179/collection/collections).

✨You can download the files from the link below, try them out, and then leave your thoughts and feedback in the comments.  
💌As a token of appreciation, we’ll be giving out **CONNECT coupons** to those who provide helpful feedback.

If this test shows that there’s strong interest in pattern files, we’ll also consider adding a dedicated **Flat Patterns category** in the future.

Your honest feedback helps us make **CONNECT** even better.  
**We’d love to hear from you, and thank you for joining this test!** 🩵**🙏**

title: FV2 Motion_Group runway show
content:
It's not a solo performance; it's a runway show with multiple avatars.

Suitable for all FV2 avatars, compatible with high heels and flats

![758dedd68dee4d079563a8af9da5c722](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/7e8939e2302243fd91eb98aaa292d1a2/images/758dedd68dee4d079563a8af9da5c722dance_1264_1.webp)

step1：Add two or more avatars

step2：Add “FV2 Motion_Group runway show” to each avatar（ps：Don‘t check 'Move Avatar&Garment to Start Position'）

[https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/6c0641c2536a41818a6a694e2a9a5d24](https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/6c0641c2536a41818a6a694e2a9a5d24)

step3：Add "A pose" or "T pose" to the first frame of each avatar and key it with a frame（ps：The keyframe function can only be used in versions 2025 and above of CLO3D）

step4：Add garment files to each avatar and simulate them one by one (ps:when simulating the first set, it is necessary to “deactivate” the subsequent sets of clothing with the avatar)

step5：Adjust the position of each set of clothing on the timeline
content_description: Showcase dynamic multi-avatar runway performances using FV2 avatars with seamless compatibility for high heels and flats.
